_comment: Documented times for the six named places of research/kcf-replay/RESULTS.md section 4, copied from research/kcf-replay/SOURCES.md (each re-read at its source on 2026-11-16; every one SINGLE = one outlet). They are REPORTED times, never outcomes of the replay: the app shows them in their own 'reported' column with the outlet, the date and the link. Times are KST. scope says what the entry is about: the village itself, its 면 or the whole county.
